## Description

Calibrates rough fractional volatility models (where volatility Hurst parameter $H &lt; 0.5$) to option smile surfaces using neural network surrogates and fractional stochastic differential equations.

## Where it may fit

Short-term options pricing, implied volatility smile fitting, volatility derivatives trading.

## Vehicles

Volatility arbitrage funds, quantitative options market makers.

## Required data

Intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surfaces, spot underlying prices.

## Caveats

Numerical simulation of fractional Brownian motion requires specialized algorithms (e.g., hybrid schemes).
